p: buildeth her house: That is, takes pains to profit her family, and to do that which concerns her duty in her house.
uprightness feareth the LORD: That is, in uprightness of heart, and without hypocrisy.
rod of pride: His proud tongue will cause him to be punished.
oxen are: By the ox is meant labour, and by the crib the barn, meaning, without labour there is no profit.
a false witness will utter lies: For the maintenance of his own ambition, and not for God's glory, as Simon Magus.
sin: Does not know the grievousness of it, nor God's judgments against the same.
bitterness: As a man's conscience is witness to his own grief, so another cannot feel the joy and comfort which a man feels in himself.
and the end of that mirth: He shows the allurement to sin, that it seems sweet, but the end of it is destruction.
shall be filled with his own: He who forsakes God will be punished, and made weary of his sins, in which he delighted.
at the gates of the righteous: If this come not daily to pass, we must consider that it is because of our sins, which hinder God's workings.
people is the king's honour: That is, the strength of a king stands in many people.
in the midst of fools is: Forasmuch as they are convicted by it, and silenced.
